_comment: B2 lifecycle rules (ADR-009), applied via the S3-compatible API by scripts/apply_b2_lifecycle.py. Hide 45 days after upload (every hackathon-period session outlives the judging window ending Aug 11, 2026), delete hidden versions 7 days later. B2's S3 layer requires the Days rule to be PAIRED with an ExpiredObjectDeleteMarker rule ('_marker' suffix, same prefix) — the pair maps to one B2-native rule.
